name: spec-driven-development
description: Write a PRD before any code. Covers objectives, commands, structure, code style, testing, and boundaries. Decompose into atomic tasks (~100 lines each) with acceptance criteria and dependency ordering. Inspired by agent-skills.

inputs.name: featureRequest
inputs.description: The feature request or user story.

outputs.name: prd
outputs.description: Product Requirements Document: objective, commands, structure, style, testing, boundaries.

outputs.name: taskBreakdown
outputs.description: Ordered list of atomic tasks, each with: description, acceptance criteria, dependencies.

failureConditions.signal: any task estimated > 100 lines of change
